summary: Relevant change: YES, one article. Between S8 (2026-01-01) and S9 (2026-03-31) D131-6-1 was re-issued as D131-6-1 LEGIARTI000053451315 (etat VIGUEUR, in force 2026-01-01 → 2999-01-01) by Décret n°2026-69 du 6 février 2026 - art. 1 (MODIFIE, JORF 2026-02-08, signé 2026-02-06, dateDebutCible 2026-02-09); nota: « entrent en vigueur le 1 er janvier 2026 et s'appliquent aux créations et reprises d'entreprise intervenant à compter de cette date ». For créations/reprises from 2026-01-01 the Acre exoneration of travailleurs indépendants (hors micro-social) drops from the whole to a quarter of the maladie-maternité / veuvage / vieillesse de base / invalidité-décès / allocations familiales cotisations below 3/4 PSS, and the degressive band becomes 0,25 E/0,25 PSS x (PSS-R). G4 still exonerates 100 %: rule `dirigeant . indépendant . cotisations et contributions . exonérations . ACRE . taux` is AFFECTED and edited (25 % branch on date de création >= 01/01/2026). The micro-social Acre rate (taux Acre 50 %) rests on a decree outside the set -> NEEDS_REVIEW, abstention, notification added. The 11 other articles are byte-identical: the auto-entrepreneur rates/shares were re-run on the new pin G4 (which adopted the M1 values: BNC 25,6 %, 2026 shares, DROM Cipav 7,8/11,6/15,5) and found UNAFFECTED, except the pre-existing DROM BNC 2026 derivation (4,4/13,1/17,4 vs 4,3/12,8/17,1) carried over as NEEDS_REVIEW + edit. Dirigeants assimilés salariés (salarié Acre rules, outside the bounded set) are affected by the same text and flagged/edited for completeness.
